title: 高盛卡普兰：若通胀顽固，9月加息或开启紧缩周期
speaker: Rob Kaplan

segments.en: I mean, personally, if inflation prints don't cool between now and we get to September, I actually think the balance of risks suggested would be wise to take some action either in September or in the fall.
segments.zh: 我个人认为，如果从现在到9月通胀数据没有降温，风险平衡表明在9月或秋季采取行动是明智的。

segments.en: I think if inflation stays sticky, it tells me that the stance is accommodative and too accommodative and we need to take action.
segments.zh: 如果通胀持续顽固，这表明政策立场是宽松的，甚至过于宽松，我们需要采取行动。

segments.en: But that's why you have a debate around the table. You're going to have people who agree with that and you have people who disagree. His job is to orchestrate and referee that debate.
segments.zh: 但这就是为什么会有辩论。有人同意，有人不同意。他的工作是组织和主持这场辩论。

segments.en: There's a difference raw between perhaps an insurance hike and entering a tightening cycle. Which of the two do you think we're in?
segments.zh: 保险性加息和进入紧缩周期之间有本质区别。你认为我们处于哪种？

segments.en: So just if you go through history and I've been part of these in the past, it is unusual for the Fed to act once. And I think if you go back through the last many years, you're going to see a one-time cut or hike is unusual.
segments.zh: 回顾历史，我过去也参与过，美联储一次性行动是不寻常的。过去很多年，一次性的降息或加息很少见。

segments.en: Normally, these moves come in twos and threes. And so I think if you move in September, you need to be prepared there could be one or two more.
segments.zh: 通常这些动作是两三次连续进行。所以如果9月行动，需要准备好可能还有一两次。

segments.en: And that's why I think the market is saying, okay, maybe they'll have to move in September and which case they might have to do another one before March, and that's why the market's reacting that way.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么市场说，好吧，也许他们必须在9月行动，然后可能在3月前再来一次，所以市场这样反应。
